# Engineering Tutorial: Designing a Reliable Service for Request Processing

## 1. Introduction

In modern distributed systems, reliability is not a feature; it is a prerequisite. Whether you are building a payment gateway, a video transcoding pipeline, or an IoT data ingestion service, the core contract remains the same: **the service must record requests, validate inputs, process jobs, and handle failures.**

This tutorial provides a comprehensive engineering guide to designing, implementing, and operating such a service. We will move beyond the simple loop of "receive and respond" to build a system that is durable, observable, and self-healing.
